integrity.claim_scope: Exact minimum relative cut/cycle projection norms for the pair-Kneser family, with integer extremum statements
integrity.proof_type: Algebraic group-averaging argument, explicit Laplacian Poisson solution and exact combinatorial edge-orbit counts
integrity.reproducibility: Standard-library check.py uses exact arithmetic and was executed from the package path

scientific_limitations: Real edge spaces only, \(n\ge5\), \(KG(n,2)\) only. Exact norms are derived at endpoint exponents; intermediate exponent norms are only proved to be attained minimally by orthogonal projections. The constants are relative to specified ambient edge coordinates. No independent scientific audit or exhaustive literature certification.
title: Exact minimal cut and cycle projections on pair-Kneser graphs
